notes.title: Hellsweeper VR Turns Two… Where’s the Update?
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/4132b9b72585ed73b514a7ec04b8e94d541d0bb5.png"]

Hey Hellsweepers, two years already! Time really does fly when you’re breakdancing with demons in hellfire. Last year we partied with the Resurgence Update for our first anniversary, and just this year we dropped the Reckoning Update (April) and Deadeye Update (July). So yeah, it makes sense that a lot of you are sharpening your blades and asking… where’s the next one?



The short answer: it’s coming. Just not today.
Now hold our beer while we explain.😉
[hr][/hr]

Our Place in the Scene
If you’ve been keeping an eye on the games industry this year, you’ll know it hasn’t been pretty. Studios big and small, VR and flatscreen, have been hit by layoffs and sudden closures. Some of those teams even made a few of our favorite VR titles. The VR scene is kind of like a small town, and it hurts when you see familiar doors close.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/0db3c01a74808447d9c3df56711dace11c74bb6e.gif"]

So when we say we’re grateful to still be around, we don’t say it lightly. That’s thanks to you. Every one of you who plays or streams any of our games, or just hangs out in the community keeps us going.
[hr][/hr]

Why Updates Take Time
In the last two updates, we kept seeing this question in one form or another: You aren't \[insert your favorite popular VR game here :p] so how do you even keep updating Hellsweeper?



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/949b5666f50df3b594df9a0eb008cf183637199a.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/3db7088e95219117db4ce4fd791c74b974840514.gif"]



Fair question. Unlike live-service games with recurring forms of revenue, Hellsweeper’s updates come straight out of one-time game sales. We’re a small crew trying to keep the game alive across multiple platforms, and every new patch means a mountain of testing, bug-hunting, and submission work before it’s ready to ship.

And because of cross-play, we can’t just push updates on one platform at a time. Everything has to go live together, or else hell really does break loose.


In fact, there’s a high chance that we might need the community’s help to test an upcoming update so we’ll be asking for a handful of volunteers (Steam only) on Discord.

All that said, we’re aiming to drop –


🤫Obscura Update: Week 2 of Oct 2025


Here’s what’s bubbling in the cauldron:

New forms of magic

A couple of new systems we can’t wait to show off related to movement, resource and skills. (edit: added)

More blessings (edit: added)

[strike]A nasty new enemy variant to make your life harder in the best way[/strike](edit: removed as this was added as a mistake)

More traits and upgrades to old favorites like Tempest and the Mage Staff

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/2fd4083cd98097f60808df9b4efb9272f85baa11.png"]

Want early glimpses? Stick around in our Discord. That’s where we’ll be teasing first.
[hr][/hr]

Thank You
Seriously, thanks for sticking with us through every swing, spin, and sweep. 

While you wait, if you want to see what else we’re cooking, check out 13Z: The Zodiac Trials. The demo is live on Steam right now. It’s not in VR, but if the community shouts loud enough, who knows what the future might bring.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3955140/13Z_The_Zodiac_Trials_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]

Note: Just a little fun dev inside joke—we tried dropping one of the characters into a Hellsweeper map while we were bored.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/21918fc875a7ab0715f25078256034b929e0abfd.gif"]

Here’s to two years of Hellsweeping and many more fiery battles to come.

Happy birthday to us. ;) 



Crafted with love,
Mixed Realms

notes.title: Reckoning Update is LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hey Hellsweepers, how is it going? 

This latest update features a new weapon, upgraded moves, and a few surprises you've been asking (and voting) for. We've said it before, and we’ll say it again: your feedback is the molten core that keeps our hellfire burning. From Discord sneak peeks to poll votes, this update has your fingerprints all over it.

▶️ Watch the Highlights Here:

[previewyoutube=6QMsNVVJjhM;full][/previewyoutube]
P.S. Share this video to give our team a virtual fist-bump! :p 

New Weapon: Chakram
The Chakram spins its way into Hellsweeper as our first-ever throwing weapon—and it’s not shy about showing off. This elegant-yet-deadly disc arcs through the air and returns to you like a loyal boomerang from hell.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/81805382f64dc9401e2ae8a116367da1a8a78453.jpg

But it doesn’t stop there. With a flick of your wrist, it can split into two separate half-blades, adding new dimensions to your mid-air mayhem. 

(Fun fact: Chakram was the third most-voted weapon in our community poll.)

Mace’s New Hookshot Update
The Mace just got a brutal upgrade. With the new Hookshot mechanic, you can now yoink enemies into the sky and then slam them down hard enough to generate a shockwave. Yes, it’s as fun (and violent) as it sounds. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/ccf035409d241f71a7448759cfffd155bf4fc042.gif

New Fist Epithet: Weaponized Knuckles
If you've been lurking in our Discord (👀 we see you), this one might look familiar.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/8da86520a7ff1ffdf0ad621e6eba5b2743d1a1d2.jpg

The latest Epithet transforms your Stone Fists into a Swiss Army knife of pure destruction. You can now attach weapons directly to your Fist. This allows you to activate two groups of weapons per fist as you can use both your trigger and grip.

Unlock Content Through Challenges
We recently ran a Discord poll based on plans to change the upgrade system. With 79% of the vote, we’re moving away from level- and soul-based unlocks. Instead, gear and items will now be tied to completing challenges owing UI that shows locked weapons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/a3342eb4250854d2114b86f31f60478ba71b799b.jpg

This also means you can access:

 Katana:  No longer purchaseable. Now unlocked by clearing a run with the Vanguard Epithet.
 Tempest: Previously unlocked at Level 4. Now unlocked by clearing a run with the Gunslinger Epithet.
 Rifle: No longer purchasable. Now unlocked by killing 300 enemies with bullets


Full Patch Notes Below
This update also includes bug fixes, quality-of-life tweaks, and some spicy under-the-hood improvements. Scroll down to check out the full list of changes. Refer to the end of the post for the full list.

Thanks again for being part of this wild ride with us. If you're enjoying Hellsweeper, consider leaving a review or sharing the video with a friend. :)

notes.title: Early Reminder for the Upcoming Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/88d62161630483d3398fa3f98496c6a7a2da3748.jpg

Hey Hellsweepers!

Our next update is nearly ready to slice its way into the fray, and with it comes a pretty major change to how you unlock weapons and gear in Hellsweeper VR.

👇

Unlocking Content will not be tied to just Souls anymore

One of the most common questions we get is… “How do I unlock [x]?”

We realized that many new players weren’t sure how to progress toward unlocking the weapons they’ve been eyeing. On top of that, we received suggestions asking for more variety in the unlock process to better highlight the depth of progression that Hellsweeper already offers.

We hear you. Previously, weapons and items were unlocked using Souls and levels. That’s changing. Starting with the upcoming update, unlocks will be tied to specific combat challenges or tasks. You'll earn your gear by proving your worth in battle.


What does this mean?


 If you’ve got Souls saved up and there’s an item you’ve been eyeing, now’s the time to spend them.
 Any content you've already unlocked will stay unlocked. No take-backs.
 This change mostly affects new players coming in fresh after the update.


What’s Changing Exactly?

Here’s how some key unlocks will now work:

 Katana – No longer purchasable. Now unlocked by clearing a run with the Vanguard Epithet.
  Tempest – No longer unlocked at Level 4. Now unlocked by clearing a run with the Gunslinger Epithet.
  Rifle – No longer purchasable. Now unlocked by killing 300 enemies with bullets.
  Volt – No longer purchasable. Now unlocked by clearing a run with the Spellcaster Epithet.
  Unholy – No longer purchasable. Now unlocked by dismembering 666 enemies.
  Bulwark – Now unlocked after clearing a run on Beginner difficulty.
  Sunwalker – Now unlocked after clearing a run on Extreme difficulty.
  Acrobat – Now unlocked after killing 150 enemies while sliding, wall-running, or in the air.
  And more..

We want Hellsweeper’s progression to feel like a true test of skill and mastery. That’s why we’re shifting to achievement-based unlocks. It rewards those who rise to Hell’s challenges.

See you in the next patch soon!

Crafted with love,
Mixed Realms Team

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/2846f16691d2c053c3e7b0dd034524891a69bf69.png

Hey Hellsweepers, are you ready to pull more friends into the fiery depths of hell? The Alliance Free Update is here -- From expanding co-op to 3 players to the all-new Gauntlet Mode, a relentless boss in Avarice, and Day & Night System, this update is packed with content that will test your endurance, teamwork, and style.

And as always, your feedback has been crucial in making this happen. So grab your weapons, rally your squad, and let’s dive in!

Watch the highlights here:
[previewyoutube=FX94y8OXVn0;full][/previewyoutube]

New Game Mode: Gauntlet
Endless. Relentless. Brutal.
The Gauntlet is a trial of pure endurance, throwing waves of enemies and bosses at you in an endless loop. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/dc0a84a00e8e957d168f7abff7772a056fad7cce.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/d8c0b287b9a7472183018c79383abbefbe8c1947.png
How far can you descend into hell before your strength gives out? This mode is available in both Single-player and Multiplayer. Bring your A-game (and a buddy or two) because hell doesn’t hold back.

Co-op now supports up to 3 players!
One of the most requested features is here—3-player co-op! Grab two friends, sharpen your blades, and see how long your alliance holds in the face of unrelenting demons. Huge thanks to our beta testers on Discord for helping us battle-proof this mode. You’re the real MVPs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/8c83933303b7a50a52713b4058f67812fc40fd6a.png
With the update finally live, our team will be doing another sweep to check the build's stability, and we thought... what better way to do it than with all of you? If you're in the mood for a co-op sweep, join us on December 12th from 9 PM to 10 PM EST for a game or a chat. We'll be opening several public rooms in the game!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/ab7d378309904137f4b34c26de5c19b3c19a815e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/e20d49e461a25a412afa6410ae0d836875fa835e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/e3edd3435618a4aacb4432f01a73055caa297f6d.gif

New Boss: Avarice
Greed has kinda ascended, and its penchant for chaos is insatiable. Meet Avarice, the wheel of destruction that rolls across the battlefield with relentless force. Simple in form, devastating in action—don’t let your guard down. Sometimes, the deadliest enemies are the ones you underestimate.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/441aed3ad870754c6d99a2c0c81f4c4089068d1f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/20222f56079bb30981ed05765cba36bbbab2f011.gif

Day & Night Mechanics
The Day & Night System brings a new layer of strategy to your runs:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/977660cdb683ef52942cf3422169038dfa453c62.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/b5ed41dd21773943dd789d8621cedbb3c1c4c0a2.png

 ☀️Daytime: Totems will remain dormant, but treasure? A little scarce. Certain enemies prefer day time.
 🌙Nighttime: Treasure chests are more abundant, but darkness brings offensive totems and more of certain enemies.


And while not necessarily related to the Day and Night mechanics, here’s a fun bonus—torches are now interactive! Light them up with Fire Magic or extinguish them with Frost Magic... just for fun. :p 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/0a709d7be478512c5f89c440039ed1a54640a3ac.gif

Show Off with Weapon Skins
What better way to celebrate dragging a third teammate to hell than showing off your weapons in style? With the addition of Weapon Skins, you can finally personalize your tools of destruction. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/29c04b21e3021a1e1fc00e9a788986565781b79b.png

Bringing Back Launch Options for Steam Players
Important: We've brought back the Runtime launch options by popular request! 

 OpenXR - This can be described as the one-size-fits-all mode. It will allow devices to use their proprietary app, eg. Oculus devices using the Meta Quest Link app. However, the customization is lacking as it is not possible to make any changes outside of the game.
 SteamVR - We recommend this to Valve Index users. This allows customization outside of the game, like putting bindings on certain buttons for controllers we don't support. The downside is that certain devices have to run their app through SteamVR, which will cause a bit of performance issues.


And as usual, there’s moar.
This update comes with a slew of improvements to make your runs smoother and deadlier than ever like new Traits, Epithets, Max Skill levels and community-requested QoLs.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/fef9897948bc11dc3424aa8452af884e393ad74c.png

Please refer to the full patch notes below. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/4af6e7f247b390ccb1eca5da90374d4b3173fed7.png
If you’ve enjoyed Hellsweeper VR’s free content updates, help us keep the fire burning! Share the game with your friends or on social media. We know it’s not a new game anymore, but we hope these updates continue to give you something to look forward to.

Lastly, you could help playtest our studio’s next game 13Z—it’s not in VR yet, but we’d love to bring it to VR if there’s enough demand from the community. Your feedback could make all the difference!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/996358e35c60a7f5ee66e189cc7c9257b6ea9a55.png

Thank you, Hellsweepers, for being part of this ever-evolving journey. From all of us at Mixed Realms, happy holidays ahead. Let’s tear through hell together one last time before the year ends!

Hey Hellsweepers, what a ride it’s been! Since launching Hellsweeper VR on September 21st last year, we've delved deep into the fiery pits together—squashed bugs, created an evil twin, added a fresh coat of paint to hell’s walls along with more enemies, and rehauled some of the systems for good measure.

And we are not done yet! A few days shy of our first birthday, we’re releasing another free content drop.

Thank you for your amazing support and suggestions, which have been instrumental in keeping the updates coming. If you love what you see and would like to toss some warm virtual hugs our way, please consider spreading the word, leaving a review for Hellsweeper, or supporting our studio’s upcoming game.😉

Hi Hellsweepers,

Coming in hot from the Wrath Update earlier this year, we’ve got a bag of new goodies to keep your sweeps in hell frantic, formidable and FRESH! 

The Ascension Update delivers the community-requested overhaul of the traits system, more elemental variants of Wrath, new ways to play melee and more! We’re able to keep updates coming because of your support. So, if you enjoy Hellsweeper, tell your friends, leave a positive review and most of all, have fun Hellsweeping!

UPDATED TRAIT SYSTEM
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/988143ec99b919c3c28be7692f4a7b9e3af2fad1.png
Let’s start with the big one. We’ve heard your pleas and by popular demand, equipping traits has been streamlined to make them more accessible yet impactful. This overhaul essentially - 

 Reduces the need to memorize more complex recipes for forging stronger traits.
 Streamlines the number of UI panels during forging.
 Shifts some of the more fun traits into a new category so they can be equipped at the start of the run instead of having to forge them later or relying on RNG.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/2c210fce0c3713c5b7143c78af6693a4952e7adc.png
Traits are now also divided into four categories:

 Normal & Rare: Both types can be equipped at the start of the run but Rare traits are more powerful and sell for more obols.
 Forged: Functionality remains the same, but the recipes have been simplified.
 Special: Reserved for traits with conflicting effects (e.g. Pump Action and Lever Action for the Shotgun). These significantly modify skills, are not stackable, and have their own specified slot. They can be brought into the run if equipped.

We’ve also removed the trait limit because… there’s always room for chaos. 

Lastly, you can now sell unwanted traits for Obols. There’s a lot you can do with a couple extra Obols in your pocket. ;)

TWO-HANDING BONUSES
With great power comes great responsibility, great enough to need both your hands to carry the sheer weight. We’ve made the Sword and Axe more deadly with some new two-handing bonuses!

Sword 
Holding the Sword with both hands will increase the hit range of your blade, perfect for those enemies that are just a little out of reach.

NEW Elemental Variants: Wrath

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/e917d30388b20c1644b9611b8d5ed546945f33f9.jpg

bHaptics Integration
Get ready for some next-level immersion! With the integration of bHaptics on Meta Quest, as well as improved integration on Steam, your dangerous encounters with the demons of Hell are about to feel more real than ever before!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/b775a3915a3814c7238e88744528281196feb5a3.png
(Available on all platforms)

Piping hot fixes with some additional QoLs. 

BUG FIXES
-[Critical] Fixed enemies becoming invisible and invulnerable, causing game soft locks.
-[Critical] Fixed Epithets preventing progress after defeating the first boss.
-[Critical] Fixed Mage Staff continuously firing Magic Ward across the map, causing lag.
-[Critical] Fixed player Epithets not setting correctly, preventing the addition of blessings and causing game soft locks.
-Fixed XP incorrectly assigned to All-Rounder Epithet when selecting an empty loadout.
-Fixed Super Me Max activating 20 times instead of 20%.
-Fixed mega laser's excessive damage per tick.
-Fixed Tempest being manually reloadable when equipped with Bullet's Liberty trait.
-Fixed elemental boss codex not unlocking.
-Fixed skill view buttons not working after unlocking all skills.
-Fixed magic balls not exploding in melee.
-Fixed Hub Crystal's text not updating with language change.
-Fixed Envy's hat displaying incorrectly on ragdolls.
-Fixed inability to change Hellhound's toy skin.
-Fixed Equip Panel not highlighting traits used for Forging.
-Fixed Hellhound not attacking in pet tutorial.
-Fixed Hellhound picking up stonefist.
-Fixed Monster Hunter, Doom Bringer, and Invoker achievements not unlocking.
-Added missing out-of-bounds (OOB) in a vault map.
-Updated bullet time code to potentially resolve bugs.
-[PSVR2] Fixed PSVR2 achievements, "A Bloody Sweep" and "Secrets of Suffering", not unlocking.
-[PSVR2] Fixed PSVR2 DLC skins not unlocking.

UPDATES
-Added one-hand pump for the pump-action shotgun.
-The rear blade will always be used first for Axe Glaive.
-Using Alt Grip with Still So Stellar allows you to shoot out all of the blades at once for Axe Glaive.
-Reduced the size of mage staff as it was affecting mobility.
-One-handed Mace attacks are now unblockable while two-handed attacks will throw enemies into the air.
-Sword receives a 20% damage increase when held in reverse grip.
-When the Indestructible Armor mod is active, armor of Frost Enemies will not be invulnerable.
-Challenger's Token will only spawn in shops now.
-Rifle and Shotgun can now be held by their offhand grips.
-Valve Index now uses Skeleton Input for better detection of the grip input.

MULTIPLAYER
-Player's Resources and EXP gained will be saved locally during MP, preventing data loss during DC.
-Loadout UI will be hidden when the player is ready in MP.
-Fixed blood crystals not spawning for clients in multiplayer.
-Fixed multiplayer rewards favoring the host.
-Fixed mega laser burning all of non-caster's mana in multiplayer.
-Fixed gore settings not toggling from the canvas menu in multiplayer, preventing enemy dismemberment.
-Fixed killing just one boss in a double boss multiplier in multiplayer ending the mission.
-Fixed clients unable to use blood magic in multiplayer.

If you prefer *new and shiny* things, don't forget to check out yesterday's sneak peek on our Discord. ;)

Crafted with Love,
Mixed Realms Team

notes.title: Wrath Update: New Enemy, New Weapon, Visual Updates and more!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/c182a06e9e2fe57eed7c2f86f458f3bce2399b1d.png

Hi Hellsweepers, Welcome to The Wrath Update -- our biggest content drop and improvements to date, featuring a new enemy, weapon, graphical upgrades, and a host of requested QoL and gameplay additions and improvements. Brace yourselves; there’s a very long list below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/760f19fa01aea688d120eb9a9d153ede952df48b.png
Your feedback has been crucial in driving us to expand our vision for this update, beyond the original scope of our roadmap. So, please keep those (crazy and wild) suggestions, bug reports and feedback coming on our Discord! 

To our Amazing Community
Thank you very much! Your support and enthusiasm are the lifeblood of Hellsweeper VR’s growth. If you enjoy our game and are thrilled about this update, leaving a positive review or sharing our game with your friends goes a long way. Every bit of love to grow the Hellsweeper VR community will empower us to keep adding more content to the game. 🙂

NEW Weapon: The Mage’s Staff
Voted by the community, the Mage’s staff is a magic focused weapon which allows you to combine all your magic elements into one weapon. This will allow flexibility to those who are also looking for a hybrid build.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/7b8189330e5c3212abdf4f7fabf628c172042900.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/bf47c02f183f34a8d31fa88b651565bc732419f0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/da1223740ec81a3931c387643c76253052626678.png

The Mage’s Staff has the following features:

 Capable of using combined magic.
 Can infuse weapons by sticking them into the staff head (For Fire, Frost, Volt and Blood)
 Has its own type of magic spells called overcharged magic.
 Has a ground slam mechanic.

Various effects can happen depending on the combination that it holds, so get out there and experiment with your wizardry!

NEW Enemy: Wrath
Completing the seven deadly sins theme for Hellsweeper’s enemies, Wrath has finally entered the depths of Hell, and is ready to give your runs a nastier time.

Wrath is a 2-in-1 Enemy that can cause double the trouble. Both parts have different combat styles, and might have other secret moves under their (missing) sleeves.

Killing either part of its body will enrage the other, so be prepared for a second wind.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/f5b8de63da16fbe88ce30362fdfc1c6e32ae49a7.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/f23e689501b3564b46cfbc0c0afed5654d6c48d4.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/e3ea44cf644144267c1fa3b6a2289a9420b849e7.png

Elemental Bosses
To turn up the challenge, Savagery, Deceit and Corruption now have elemental variants to them. For those seeking a bigger threat, they have unlocked more moves and surprises that can enhance your run…or make it worse.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/69d3438590c67bebaf946c140fc6f9131b69111d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/564f00219f0e021c7cd4a23b5fa5155b44471ca1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/2e10f01df01c28eb7a9c5a7e39f43bf04aa0eefb.png

And as promised in our roadmap, we’ve also added more details and props to the boss arenas!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/7f3c42de61d7d7a63359ccf9b3b37004fe40cd0d.png

NEW Gameplay Additions

Epithets
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/aad1ede4a8a1db965458f2d7ae923885c7ba4f70.png

We have added Epithets, a class and reward system for different playstyles. The player's level is transferred to the 'All-Rounder' Epithet. Whether you are looking for balance, spellcasting or even enjoy having more buddies with you, Epithets will reward you for making a distinctive decision!


 All-Rounder - Balanced Stats with no special mechanics.
 Vanguard - Lean towards melee combat, parry attacks and projectiles with your head.
 Gunslinger - Enemies drop ammo when killed; gun's bullets will be refilled when ammo drops are picked up.
 Spellcaster - A magic orb will orbit around the player when spells are conjured.
 Acrobat - Increased jump and damage when in the air, Reduced hitbox size.
 Tamer - Have an additional friend fighting together with you.
 Vengeance - Similar to All Rounder but with enhanced stats and reduced resource gains.


Summoning Enemy Weapons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/8f4e2c9fd175f596fb06a3998dc7efad1d9bbb8c.png
Another community suggestion! You’ll now be able to equip enemy weapons! At Unholy Rank 5, players can equip and conjure enemy weapons such as:


 Pride's Katana
 Gluttony's Cleaver
 Envy's Scythe
 Wrath's Cleaver


😀These are just the highlights of the changes affecting gameplay. There are also updates to some skills, new traits and blessings and other much-requested QoL improvements in the full patch notes below.

Visual Improvements

PCVR
Apart from replacing a couple of low-poly props, lighting was given an overhaul after we converted our unity render pipeline to URP. In addition, PCVR (and PSVR2) also received freshly mint hair and fur! The Hellhound enjoys his new, sleek look.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/4b171e45452b0252d3fef23221ad4055a31cd8de.png

PlayStation®VR2

For PlayStation®VR2, we have officially implemented Dynamic Foveated Rendering.

To make this happen, we had to update our Unity version, switch from the Standard Pipeline to the Universal Render Pipeline, update all the lighting and shaders, and redo elements that were not supported by our new workflow. 

It took us a solid six months, a period during which we essentially had to take the game apart and put it back together. We started this journey fully aware of our promise to the community, determined to see it through, no matter the effort required.

Looking back, it wasn't just about improving our technical processes; it was also a chance for us to grow as a team and as individuals. A huge thanks goes out to everyone involved: to those who challenged us to do better, pushing us beyond our limits, and to those who stood by us, cheering us on every step of the way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/fa1b55b5d7b7e29f0c539e07fe9744b8317b4963.png
[previewyoutube=2DSeJyfntoQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Meta Quest 2 & 3
Meta Quest 2 and 3 have received major lighting updates with some tweaks in texture resolution. Finally, enemy textures were painted over to make their details pop.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/c55c34d603d408ec77cb448f1faaa2718977fa3e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/2b0aa719d73a2b4bac254bd7c51845ae7345a297.png

Apart from Quest 3’s native resolution bump, the Quest 3 VFX also has higher particle count and visual fidelity than Quest 2.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/34516e2415d1984b9b1bf3077e0ac509fbfbfaf4.png

Patch 1.4 Full Wrath Update Patch Notes
⭐ Means this update was a Community Suggestion!

Main Gameplay Additions / Updates:

ENEMY ADDITIONS:

 Wrath has been added
 Act Bosses now have their elemental variants. *Elemental Boss crystals will only appear if the player has previously defeated the base version.


NEW WEAPON:

 ⭐Added a new skill, the "Mage Staff," which can be purchased from the Blacksmith at Level 4. You can find its new traits below.


OTHER SKILL-RELATED UPDATES:

 Added imperfect infusions for 'Blood Magic', different combinations of elements will result in slightly different spells.
         - Blood + Fire
         - Blood + Frost
         - Blood + Volt
 ⭐Players can now bring Sweeper's Broom into the Roguelike Run.
 ⭐At Unholy Rank 5, players can equip and conjure enemy weapons such as:
         - Pride's Katana
         - Gluttony's Cleaver
         - Envy's Scythe
         - Wrath's Cleaver
 Added Epithets, a class and reward system for different playstyles.
         - All-Rounder - Balanced Stats with no special mechanics.
         - Vanguard - Lean towards melee combat, parry attacks and projectiles with your head.
         - Gunslinger - Enemies drop ammo when killed; gun's bullets will be refilled when ammo drops are picked up.
         - Spellcaster - A magic orb will orbit around the player when spells are conjured.
         - Acrobat - Increased jump and damage when in the air, Reduced hitbox size.
         - Tamer - Have an additional friend fighting together with you.
         - Vengeance - Similar to All Rounder but with enhanced stats and reduced resource gains.
 Added map modifier, 'Treasure Box', for use in the roulette.	


NEW TRAITS:

 Study Me (Mage Staff) - Increase damage of spells.
 Dragon Tune (Mage Staff) - When using groundbreaker spells, Mage Staff is infused with a random element.
 Just Dazzling Mana (Mage Staff) - Reduce mana cost of spells.
 Mana Killer (Mage Staff) - Increase damage of groundbreaker spells but also increasemana cost.
 Next One (Mage Staff) - Using a spell will switch Mage Staff to the next element.
 ⭐Mixed Nuts (Mage Staff) - Stats and traits of the respective skills will be used. 
 Circus Fennec (Bow) - Adds a hookshot for the bow.
 Devil's Trigger (Blood Magic) - Allows Blood Magic to be equipped like a regular skill.
 Packin' Pain (Bullets) - Increase the number of damage buff stacks per Manual Reload.
 Sight Guidance (Mace) - Adds a laser sight to the Mace when using Hookshot.
 Sweat & Iron (Gun) - Guns will no longer become damaged when at low durability.


NEW BLESSINGS

 Play Dice - Allows players to reroll blessings and traits. Hi
 UR My Special - Enemies take increased damage when affected by status effects.
 Invisible Pain - Players are immune to environmental hazards.


Graphical Changes

Improved overall lighting for all platforms.
 Decorated the Boss Arenas.
 Added Ambient Occlusion for improved lighting appearance. [PC Only]
 Enhanced overall shadow quality for improved visual fidelity. [PSVR2 Only]
 Improved Textures of Enemies. [QUEST Only]
 Improved VFX. [QUEST 3 Only]
 Improved the hair shader (quality) of enemies. [PC and PSVR2 Only]
 Updated Hellhound textures for the normal Hellhound, Bloodhound, and Mystic Hellhound skin variants. [PC and PSVR2 Only]
 Added Boss altars to enhance visual presentation in the mission canvas area in the hub map.


General Updates

 Adjusted the node just before the boss to always feature Vault.	
 Moved Blacksmith to the right side of the mission area for easier accessibility.	
 Introduced a Parkour area in the training island of the hub map.	
 Revised Totem-related Mission mechanics to require players to defeat remaining enemies after destroying the totems.	


Updates & Changes to Player Progression, Skills and Abilities

 Increased the level cap to 100. Upon reaching Level 100, players can undergo a "Promotion Test" to boost their "Prestige".
 ⭐ Added Shoulder and Hip Slots. 
 ⭐ Added color customization for weapons and hellhound. 
 Added the ability to lock in traits and blessings, allowing players to bring their selected traits and blessings into the Roguelike run from the Blacksmith.	
 Adjusted the stats and increased the number of trait slots for all skills.	
 Increased the number of trait slots for all skills.	
 ⭐ Players can now infuse magic into their hands without needing the Unarmed skill. 
 ⭐ Players can now bring Sweeper's Broom into the Roguelike Run. 
 ⭐ Stonefist now earns bonuses from the unarmed combo and can prolong it. 
 ⭐ The 'None' modifier in the roulette mission has been replaced with 'Mod Removal', which removes an existing map modifier from the run. 


CHANGES TO EXISTING BLESSINGS:

 Pumping Iron: It will now convert a percentage of mana into health instead of providing a full conversion.
 Magic Overflow: It will now convert a percentage of health into mana instead of providing a full conversion.


CHANGES TO EXISTING TRAITS/SKILLS:

 Liberty (Bullets) - In addition to reducing mana cost of conjuring bullets to zero, if Bullets are equipped to either the (Shoulder) or (Hip) slots, players can reload guns by bringing them close to the slots.
 Lever-Action (Shotgun) will be available at Rank 1.
 Silver Core (General) will be available at Rank 1.
 Enhanced Grapple (Mace) - Reduced the reeling speed multiplier.
 Hellhound:
         - Damage now scales based on the weapon it holds.
         - Infusing the Hellhound's toy will infuse the Hellhound as well.
         - Added customisation for the Hellhound.	
 The following skills will no longer unlock through leveling and must be purchased from the Blacksmith:
Available for purchase at level 4
         - Volt
         - Unarmed
         - Shotgun
Available for purchase at level 7
         - Rifle
         - Mace
         - Unholy
*Players who have already unlocked these skills will retain them.


Enemy Updates

 Added codex entry for Wrath.	
 Breaking Deceit's arms will massively damage its shield.	
 Enemy projectile speed modifier has been changed so that they move slower instead of having a weaker launch force.	
 Frost enemies will be adorned with Frost Crystals on their bodies, providing them with additional armor. They will take reduced damage until all of their armor is broken.	
 Fire enemies will drop explosive bombs upon death.	
 Volt enemies will now move faster.	
 In lower difficulties, enemies will move slower.	
 Increased the enemy stats slightly in Roguelike.	
 Reduced the frequency and projectile count of Pride's AOE attacks.	
 Reduced the frequency of Air Bubble and Meteor. They will also damage enemies when the hazards detonate.	
 UI Updates
 Adjusted the loadout canvas layout to accommodate Infinite Triangle functionality.	
 Enhanced visibility of rank up arrows in various areas, facilitating easier identification of skills ready for ranking up.	
 Introduced a new blue bar for temporary shields that will decay overtime.
 Implemented a new highlight sprite to emphasize upgradeable skill perks.	
 Shifted the Reset Data button into the options menu for improved accessibility.	
 Relocated the Tutorial UI to the main missions altar, ensuring a more intuitive user experience.	
 Transferred the hand infusion tutorial to the advanced magic tutorial.	


Balancing & QoL 

 ⭐Treasure Chest and Treasure Key system overhaul.:
         - Keys will now float towards the player instead of requiring manual pickup. Players will have an inventory for keys, accessible via the pause menu, where they can see the total keys collected.
         - To unlock treasure chests, the keys will now appear above the treasure chest itself, so players can just pick which key they want to use from there.
         - From now on, there will only be 3 types of treasure chest keys: Silver, Gold and Jade, each having a different value.
         - Jade Keys can only be purchased through the shop. It is a powerful key that unlocks all locks.
         - Once inserted, used keys cannot be removed, and the multiplier for that used key will apply,                   even if a Jade key is inserted into any remaining available slots.
 Added Axe Glaive to the Bladewave Aim Assist.	
 Added an option to change how Bow aiming works in Options > Gameplay.	
 Added Quick Dash, allowing players to dash based on locomotion direction in Options > Gameplay.
 Adjusted the spawn rate of rewards to favor the initial starting loadout.
 Adjusted the stat progression of Traits, Blessings, and Skill Augments.
 Changed "Reduced Loot" modifier to "Reduced Shop Prices".	
 Increased the levitation from 0.2 to 0.4
 Made it easier to perform Bladewave and Axe Glaive.
 The Clue Crystal's hints can be cycled.


Multiplayer

 Players can now invite their friends who are currently in a different region.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed the issue where totems in MP would still attack players in non-combat missions such as Trove, Roulette, and Tribute.
 Fixed the issue where players might not have their portals spawned at the same position in MP, leading to a black screen when loading into the wrong portal.
 Fixed a bug where killing and dismembering enemies in melee would cause the body parts to not spawn at the correct location.	
 Resolved a bug where, when set to static, enemies like Greed would not cling to the walls in Training mode.


PSVR2 FEATURE-SPECIFIC UPDATES

 Implemented Dynamic Foveated Rendering for PlayStation®VR2.
 Eye Tracking:
         - Ensure that Eye Tracking is enabled and calibrated on the system. Navigate to Settings >          - Accessories > PlayStation VR2 > Eye tracking.
         - Recalibrate your eye tracking for optimal performance. 
         - Navigate to Settings > Accessories > PlayStation VR2 > Enable Eye Tracking > Adjust Eye Tracking. Additionally, adjust Lens Distance and VR Headset Position under Settings > Accessories > PlayStation VR2 > VR headset.
 Improved GFX with 3 available options for PlayStation®VR2:
         - Performant - Improved Particles
         - Optimal (Default) - Improved Clarity
         - Quality - Improved Particles & Clarity
 Enabled eye-tracking with telekinesis for PlayStation®VR2.
         - In the game settings, navigate to Options > Gameplay, then change Levitation Direction to Eye Tracking."
 Added adaptive trigger when using and levitating ranged weapons. (Tempest, Rifle, Shotgun and Pistol)

notes.title: A Peek into our upcoming Wrath Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/5e7b7295ac64dd61348771a95c43b2a9acd81531.jpg

Hey Hellsweepers!

Today, we’re going to let you guys have an in-depth look at what we have been up to for the past few months! Come step into our workspace, which showcases some *really* behind-the-scenes early footage of our current progress for Hellsweeper VR...

Watch the video here:

[previewyoutube=E9IaHafenqo;full][/previewyoutube]

Let’s dive a little deeper into our upcoming content!

*Everything shown is still a work in progress.

NEW WEAPON!

About the Katana…
Okay, we hear you! We know, you want the Katana (as do we!). We can safely say a Katana is cooking behind the scenes, so don’t fret. Our main goal is to ensure it has its own identity separate from the Sword, brainstorming unique mechanics and gameplay. 

But that means we will have something else in our upcoming update and it is…

The Magician’s Staff!

Our runner-up is the Magician’s Staff, which some of you might have managed to crack with the puzzle we posted on Discord’s sneak peek ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/8101e8838e18484d751fa8b3c3a255fc14701b9b.jpg

The Magician’s Staff is a magic-focused weapon which fits those who are looking to bring their magical combat to the next level. Using the staff in various ways can offer more effects when you combine your magic balls. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/b8386c22c8fa89dda122535a7dd52c61d3d71f18.gif

The staff is able to be slammed or can be pointed forward, giving different effects and attacks depending on the elements equipped. In addition, you no longer need two hands to combine spells, allowing your free hand to shoot, slice or punch.

Different effects can happen when you mix-and-match your elements! So for those who enjoy playing wizardry, you can start preparing your spells 😛…

Wrath
The new star of the show, Wrath, has been creeping around on our platforms lately. In case you missed it, here’s a little glimpse of our 2-in-1 enemy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/bacd5844d2ee440eceb9fb67a41472672bde458a.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/bb6a5e87f42622460757d30cbc92edc036f9cc06.jpg

Elemental Bosses
As seen in the video, we’re going to be giving our bosses a little magic to spice things up ;) Elemental bosses were originally not in our roadmap, but we wanted to add more variety to the Boss fights while adding another layer of difficulty for more experienced Hellsweepers. 

They will have new movesets and amped up attacks, such as a Fire based Savagery leaving lava pools on the floor or setting up fountains of fire. 

These elemental upgrades will be available to all bosses (Except Treachery). Corruption and Deceit will be waiting for you, too, with new cards up their sleeves :P 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/0c455ebd1e0837af4cf0f2cb81f01f641e46f44a.gif

Visual Improvements
Finally, we have our visual improvements for PSVR2, PCVR and Quest 2 & 3.

For PSVR2, as mentioned before, our team has been hard at work shifting our Unity render pipeline from Standard to Universal since launch. This is to enable us to make use of Foveated Rendering to improve overall performance and visuals. We’re close to the finish line, and PSVR2 will be granted a big overhaul very soon. If you want to keep track of these updates and see them before they drop, you can join our Discord or follow us on Twitter and Reddit!

Quest 2 and 3 will also be given some visuals updates. Here’s an example of one of our environment adjustments:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/f7c3ef5e3dc80111110a6e3a04a223e8d9f5bbb8.png
In addition, environments on all platforms will have some smaller scale upgrades, such as updated environmental objects with higher fidelity. Time to sack the sacks :P…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/84e60c5b35cf8bfdf22dc4d14af67e2f57451da0.png
We’ve got a lot in store as mentioned above! From a new weapon (courtesy of our community’s voice.), a new enemy and upgraded bosses, we hope Hellsweepers look forward to the fresh meat to grind soon.

Hi Hellsweepers,

The holiday season is upon us and we’ve a treasure trove of NEW content in Hellsweeper VR! It's packed with fresh features, including a formidable new boss, new weapons, co-op improvements and other highly requested updates. Dive into the details below for more!

[previewyoutube=4ds3JmM0XpY;full][/previewyoutube]

Keep an eye on our Discord for more updates, and we can't thank you enough for your unwavering support.  If you're feeling festive, sharing Hellsweeper with friends this Christmas would mean a lot to our team.

Now let’s get down to this long list of stuff…

CO-OP Acts increased from 1 to 3

We heard you! Many of you have been asking and waiting for an extended Co-Op experience and we’re finally ready to roll it out. Along with new acts, we’ve also added Roulette and Tribute missions. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/1963a3867ecd894c894edf07e9bae00439aa6f91.png

We’d also like to extend our gratitude to those who took part in our Extended Co-Op BETA. Your feedback has allowed us to make Co-op a longer, more complete experience.

NEW Boss: Treachery

There’s more to face than the ghouls and mooks that appear in Hell - they’re not the only creatures that need to be cleansed. Behind the fog, there lies an enemy one must face: themselves.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/464cca6d02b63adbe292e2d47b69862d80c20489.png

Beating him unlocks something else too, which will be spoiler tagged in the notes.

NEW Weapons & Blacksmith

With great responsibility to cleanse hell of its errant demons comes great power.

Meet the Blacksmith

Just a little to the left of the Hall, a new ally has appeared. Eternally bound to the forge, The Blacksmith is forever tied to his job in life and death. The Blacksmith is now the place for you to rank up and augment your weapons and adjust your loadouts. He doesn't have much to say but rest assured, he does his job well!

Loadouts can now be set before beginning your runs so if you want a specific set of weapons, you can do that!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/6ca9880bc6faeefcae8b76298c643132de546896.png

NEW Weapon: Tempest

For those looking for that high rate of fire, we have added in a new weapon: Tempest. While unable to be held with two hands, the Tempest is perfect for those who like a snappy, rapid fire gun.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/6184ddb1fc572a51f2f8fcf3bdcfc8d35d6ecef7.gif

 Does not have alternate fire, but has an overheat function.

 Overheat mode reduces the fire rate of the tempest 
 When infused with volt magic, the tempest fires 3 bullets per shot akin to a shotgun.

We also have a secret weapon that you’ll have to earn… ;)

Want to go down the endless rabbit hole? We have now included Endless Mode where avid Hellsweepers can test how far they can go.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990244/96d9e76c3b28f5cfa01006b90cdd9cfc4a1256f2.png

Hi Hellsweepers,

Patch 1.2 has arrived on all platforms!

In this patch, we've got another long list of QoL, balance tweaks, and progression improvements lined up for you. Exploding enemies giving you trouble? They’ll now drop bombs as a warning, giving you more time to react.

We've also fine-tuned hand offsets for a range of weapons like the bow, axe, shotgun, and rifle based on your invaluable input.  Added option to completely disable dash/teleport on the thumbstick.
 Added option to end Bullet Time when a dash, jump, or somersault is performed.
 Added option to use the trackpad instead of thumbstick click for Valve Index devices. [PCVR Only]
 Added option for delayed grip to release objects after a short amount of time.
 Added option for Bladewave Aim-Assist, the bladewave will fly towards where the headset is facing.
 Improved the hand offsets when using the Bow, Axe, Shotgun, and Rifle.

 Added a UI pop-up that explains what happens when the player leaves a run.
 Removed the Lobby button..

 Barrels will explode when they are shot.
 Players can now fan the pistol while their other hand is occupied.
 The enemy health bar will change color to reflect its status, indicating whether it is invulnerable, blocking, or has shields.
 Updated somersault, somersaulting will provide better angles for easier attacking.
 When a golden totem is broken, it will spawn a golden wisp that will fly to the closest treasure chest.

 Auxiliary skills no longer gain mastery when their respective skills gain mastery. Auxiliary skill crystals have been added.
 Both Gluttony and Fire Minion's thrown projectile have been changed to a bomb, exploding only after a delay

notes.title: Important News Regarding the Release of Hellsweeper VR
notes.notes:
Dear Hellsweepers,

We have made the very difficult decision to postpone Hellsweeper VR’s release to Q2 2023 to give our team sufficient time to deliver a game that meets our vision.

While we have been working very hard towards originally releasing the game in Q4 2022, we want to be able to give more to Hellsweeper VR and the community cheering behind it whose support has been a huge part of what inspires us to power through. 

Our team is hell-bent on delivering a robust and solid roguelike VR experience with many maps, enemy types, customizable skills bolstered by a huge selection of traits, and more. Putting all these elements together harmoniously requires multiple rounds of polish from balancing to optimization, and this is what we will be focusing on in the next few months. 

We believe we have a great game on our hands and are willing to make every decision, even the hard ones, if this ultimately leads to delivering a much better experience. 

We will continue to showcase our progress through our regular devlogs and sneak peeks on Discord or Twitter to keep you all in the loop. As always, we welcome your feedback, suggestions and questions. 

We thank the community who’s been with us through this journey. We remain committed to delivering a VR game that we hope will be worthy of your patience and continued support.

Crafted with Love,
The Mixed Realms Team
